intro: Football is Paraguay's passion, and the Guaraní Albirroja has reached many World Cups.

chapters.title: Football
text: Paraguay won the Copa América in 1953 and 1979 and reached the World Cup quarter-finals in 2010. It also won Olympic silver in 2004.

chapters.title: Legends
text: José Luis Chilavert was a goalkeeper who scored goals from free kicks and penalties.
